description: This file defines the ImageRenderInfo class, which provides rendering details specific to images within the MigraDoc document rendering framework.

classes.name: ImageRenderInfo
classes.description: A sealed class representing rendering information for images, extending ShapeRenderInfo, and providing access to image-specific format details.

methods.name: FormatInfo
methods.description: A property that gets or sets the format information for the image, returning an ImageFormatInfo object.
